patch_description: The previous edit's added mid-circuit RY gates (ry_mid_0..3) increased parameter count by 24 (186 vs 162) but slightly hurt validation accuracy and generalization gap versus the leaner seed variant. Revert those local single-qubit insertions and instead add genuine three-qubit entangling structure (allowed anywhere, no wire restrictions) to link the three previously disjoint entangling clusters (hub-0 cluster, 1-3-5 chain, 2-4-8 chain, and the 5-7/6-7 tail) more globally. Two ZZZ gates sharing one parameter connect qubit 0 (hub) with 4 and 7 (bridging the far clusters), and connect 1, 5, 6 (bridging the chain and tail clusters). This adds richer, higher-order correlations that could better mix information across the graph while keeping the parameter budget low via aggressive sharing (only 1 new shared parameter total instead of 4 independent RY parameters removed), which should reduce overfitting risk (smaller generalization gap) while ideally recovering the higher validation accuracy of the original seed.
